results.name: Steam Deck/Xbox/DualSense standard mapping has identical four axes
Connect held controls/buttons require release and never arm automatically
A requires fresh press-release and centred axes; held A cannot repeat
UI Arm requires current neutral axes and released buttons rather than latched readiness
Qualified Arm retains neutral pickup when throttle rises on the next frame
Menu/flight scope handoff releases throttle and pending gestures
Throttle integrates only fixed samples; centre holds and negative lowers
Dead zone stops drift and full axes retain full travel
D-pad/bumpers/triggers are flight fallbacks; analog has priority
Back Start Reset release actions occur once and clear flight outputs
Fire held on connect cannot fire; X only fires inside active scope
Disconnect and device replacement pause once, zero output and demand neutral
Unmapped radios, excluded calibrated device and malformed axes never fly
Multiple controllers preserve selected device until loss
Stall and focus loss cannot catch up throttle or rearm held inputs
Preview seeding has no ownership effect and reset removes seed
Legacy input owner remains inert for external controller and radio
Disposed adapter stays silent and releases listeners

scope: Production adapter with explicit standard Gamepad-shaped samples and controlled event targets. Actual browser module; controlled Gamepad-shaped samples/event targets, no physical device or added unit-suite claim.
